description.value: You N Me' Cafe bills itself as BC's first Humanity Cafe — a community coffee shop founded by Amrin, an immigrant from India whose own experience of isolation drove her to create a space where no one has to feel alone. The cafe serves coffee alongside a program of community gatherings, a belonging initiative, and a WhatsApp community group, making it a genuinely social stop rather than a transactional one.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and content-rich, confirming the cafe is open as of 2026. A critical address discrepancy exists: OSM places this record in North Vancouver, but the website footer clearly states '921 12th Street, New Westminster, BC, Canada' and the coordinates (~49.21°N, ~122.94°W) are consistent with New Westminster, not North Vancouver. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Address/community mismatch: OSM assigns this record to North Vancouver, but the website footer explicitly states '921 12th Street, New Westminster, BC, Canada'. The coordinates (~49.21°N, ~122.94°W) are geographically consistent with New Westminster, not North Vancouver. The OSM community tag and possibly the node placement should be reviewed and corrected.

Website pages show 'filler@godaddy.com' as the signed-in account name, indicating residual GoDaddy template artifacts. The business content and contact information appear genuine, but the site may not have been fully configured.
OSM record has no phone number; the phone 672-335-6858 was sourced from the website footer only and could not be cross-confirmed against an OSM value.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe with a live website and clear contact details; the address/community mismatch is a data quality issue that warrants correction but not exclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: The menu subpage did not render substantive content, so food offerings (dietary options, takeout availability) could not be confirmed from the website.

wow_evidence: BC's first Humanity Cafe — a community coffee shop founded by Amrin
